description.message: Checks, by hand and only for names you say are yours, on which websites a username exists. Finds accounts; it does not delete them.

uc_lead.message: Type a username you use. Klin asks hundreds of websites if that name exists there. Only when you press the button.

uc_own.message: This is my own username. I am not looking for someone else.

uc_found_note.message: To remove an account, open it and look for the deletion option in its settings. Klin deletes nothing for you.

uc_unknown_note.message: Blocked, slow, rate limited or down. Open them yourself to be sure.

uc_not1.message: **It does not delete accounts.** It only finds them.

uc_not2.message: **It can be wrong.** A site may use the same name for someone else, or answer in a way Klin reads badly.

uc_not3.message: **It searches usernames only.** Not your email, your phone number or what data brokers hold.

uc_not4.message: ==Every site you check sees the request==, with your IP address and the name you typed. Nothing goes to Klin or anyone else, and nothing is saved when you close the page.

uc_not5.message: Sites get no cookies from you: you are not logged in and no session is touched.

uc_not6.message: Klin asks your permission to contact websites when you press Check. You can refuse.

uc_source.message: The list of sites comes from the open-source Sherlock project (MIT licence), fixed at one version and kept inside Klin.

uc_noperm.message: Without permission to contact websites the check cannot run. Nothing was sent.

uc_done.message: Done. {1} found, {2} not found, {3} unclear, {4} skipped (the name cannot exist there).

uc_stopped.message: Stopped. {1} found, {2} not found, {3} unclear, {4} skipped (the name cannot exist there).
